name: sniper
description: SNIPER — India's Intelligent Lending Operating System (LOS + LMS + CRM + Credit + Collections)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npx esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/app.bundle.js
